text:
Marjorie: Quick spike from today's design review on the catalog compare UI. Two issues: (1) metric chips push the row height when they wrap, (2) the version pin label is inconsistent across flows. Need proposals.

Tao: For metrics, how about showing a compact inline summary (e.g., "latency · cost") and a "+more" chevron that opens a popover with full metrics? Keeps rows tight.

Ravi: +1 to +more chip. Accessibility: make the chip keyboard focusable and provide aria-expanded / aria-controls. Also ensure the popover is dismissible with Esc and returns focus to the trigger.

Elena: Microcopy thought: replace "+more" with "View metrics (3)" so it's explicit. Shorter variant for mobile: "Metrics". Consistency with other tooltips matters.

Tao: Good call. I'll mock both: desktop shows "View metrics (3)", mobile shows "Metrics". Popover header will have a short summary line: "Performance metrics for this model version".

Marjorie: Pin label: currently some screens show "Pin version" and others show "Pin to compare". Which do we standardize on?

Ravi: Prefer "Pin to comparison" — verb + destination reads clearer. Add tooltip: "Pin this version so it stays in your current comparison". Also add a visible pinned state (left badge + subtle background).

Elena: A11y nit: pinned state currently only uses a colored outline. Add an aria-pressed on the control and a visible icon+text for low-vision users. Contrast token suggestion: use success-600 for the icon and a 2px focus ring.

Tao: Implementation caveat: our virtualized list unmounts nodes on scroll. If the pin control is in a cell that unmounts, keyboard users lose focus. Suggest roving tabindex pattern or moving the pin control into a fixed column. Thoughts?

Ravi: Roving tabindex is less invasive. If we can track focused index and reassign tabIndex on remount, that should be stable. Fixed column is nicer visually but requires syncing with virtualization (more work). Either is acceptable if we follow a11y rules.

Marjorie: Mobile behavior: when space is tight, should metric summary collapse into a single chip that opens a bottom sheet? Thumb reach and clarity are priorities.

Elena: Bottom sheet + single summary chip is my vote. Use larger touch target and make the sheet header announce the metric count. Also debounce live metric updates in the sheet so screen readers aren't spammed.

Tao: I'll create figma frames for: (A) desktop inline summary + popover, (B) mobile summary chip + bottom sheet, (C) pinned-row visual state. Will include notes on keyboard interactions.

design-bot: Figma frames uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/.../catalog-compact-metrics-iter1 — comments enabled for @Marjorie @Tao @Ravi @Elena.

Marjorie: Great, please leave final microcopy proposals here by EOD. Let's standardize on "Pin to comparison" and "View metrics (N)" unless anyone objects.

Ravi: No objections. Small add: telemetry event for "metrics_popover_opened" and "pin_toggled" so PM can see usage.

Elena: Adding a11y QA checklist: 1) popover focus trap, 2) aria-expanded on triggers, 3) live region debounce, 4) contrast checks for icons.

Marjorie: Thanks team. We'll merge copy + a11y fixes into the next patch and schedule the mobile sheet for the following sprint. Drop final nits here.
